scope: Custom — Chicago Bears @ Seattle Seahawks only
scope_description: NFL Week 8, 2026 Regular Season — tonight's game only: Chicago Bears @ Seattle Seahawks, Monday November 2, 2026, 8:15 PM ET

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 7
historical_cutoff.cutoff: Immediately after actual completion of the final scheduled Week 7 game; Stage 1 must verify completion and exclude all Week 8 games.

methodology.core_rule: American odds -350 through -150 inclusive; select odds numerically closest to -250; ties select the more negative price.
methodology.floor_rule: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than CORE.
methodology.ceiling_rule: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than CORE, regardless of HR.
methodology.alternate_hr_rule: Hits divided by locked Stage 1 L10; Over wins when historical stat >= alternate threshold.
methodology.candidate_narrowing_rule: Carry candidates with a valid price-target CORE; exclude only where no valid CORE exists. No context-based exclusions.
